review_units.intended_behavior: Centralize the production SQLite target, reject production and non-temporary SQLite access under tests, and construct the SQLAlchemy engine lazily.

review_dimensions.production_db_behavior: Normal runtime retains configured SQLite engine creation; this packet does not open the production database.
review_dimensions.test_environment_behavior: Pytest, APP_ENV testing values, AI_MEDIA_OS_TESTING, and pytest argv signals force isolated targets below /tmp.
review_dimensions.sqlite_uri_path_behavior: Raw paths, sqlite URLs, and file URIs are normalized before the fail-closed directory and inode checks.
review_dimensions.symlink_hardlink_behavior: Resolved/lexical production-directory aliases and hard links to the protected inode are rejected during tests.
review_dimensions.lazy_engine_behavior: Importing session no longer creates or connects an engine; creation occurs on first get_engine/SessionLocal use.
review_dimensions.wal_behavior: WAL is enabled only for non-test SQLite connections; tests do not enable WAL.
review_dimensions.import_time_side_effects: No engine construction, connection, or PRAGMA occurs on import.

review_units.rollback_considerations: Treat config, access_guard, and session as one rollback unit. A rollback must not silently restore import-time production database side effects.
review_units.security_impact: Fail-closed production database targeting is strengthened without a permission expansion.
review_units.data_integrity_impact: Incorrect target classification can block valid runtime use or expose the production database to tests, so human review is mandatory.
review_units.performance_impact: Path resolution and inode checks add bounded setup overhead; engine construction is deferred.
known_limitations: Bind-mount aliasing cannot be proven absent portably.
Production behavior is reviewed from source and isolated tests, not by opening the production SQLite database.
test_evidence_gaps: No test deliberately restores the old import-time side effect because that behavior must not be reintroduced.

review_units.intended_behavior: Validate and store a positive WordPress post ID without writing it into the restricted workflow-history value field, then reconcile draft status.

review_dimensions.wordpress_post_id_behavior: Boolean, zero, negative, empty, and nonnumeric values fail; a positive integer is normalized to text; None clears the value.
review_dimensions.workflow_transition_impact: mark_wordpress_draft_created updates the post ID and requests DRAFT status only.
review_dimensions.duplicate_handling: Writing the same normalized post ID is idempotent; cross-item uniqueness is not enforced here.
review_dimensions.repository_mutation_boundary: The repository mutates the supplied ORM item and flushes the caller-owned session.
review_dimensions.transaction_behavior: Commit/rollback remains owned by the surrounding service/session boundary.
review_dimensions.approval_binding: This repository has no authority to issue approval; callers remain responsible for the approval transition.
review_dimensions.failure_stop_behavior: Invalid values raise before mutation; surrounding service tests require rollback on illegal transitions.

review_units.rollback_considerations: Confirm no callers depend on the new post-ID methods before reverting; preserve the production workflow-history schema constraint.
review_units.security_impact: Mutation remains within a caller-owned transaction but affects approval-driven workflow state.
review_units.data_integrity_impact: Post ID and draft status must remain coordinated and must not create a disallowed history record.
review_units.performance_impact: At most two flush-backed repository changes are added to draft reconciliation.
known_limitations: Cross-item WordPress post ID uniqueness is not enforced by this repository.
unresolved_issues: Human review must decide whether cross-item post ID reuse needs a separate invariant.
test_evidence_gaps: No focused test injects a failure between post-ID flush and draft-status flush inside mark_wordpress_draft_created.
No focused test covers cross-item duplicate WordPress post IDs.

review_units.intended_behavior: Delay Slack Bolt loading until worker construction, allow factory injection, report a fixed missing-dependency error, and close Socket Mode once on SIGTERM or KeyboardInterrupt.

review_dimensions.slack_bolt_lazy_import: Slack Bolt is imported only by load_slack_runtime during explicit app construction.
review_dimensions.factory_injection: Tests can supply app/handler factories without starting the real Socket Mode client.
review_dimensions.idempotent_close: WorkerStopController.close_once prevents duplicate handler close calls.
review_dimensions.signal_behavior: SIGTERM requests stop by raising KeyboardInterrupt into the common shutdown path.
review_dimensions.keyboard_interrupt_behavior: KeyboardInterrupt is treated as controlled shutdown and closes the handler once.
review_dimensions.startup_shutdown_sequence: Config, app, handler, signal handler, start, and final close remain ordered.
review_dimensions.secret_boundary: Configuration status prints presence only; token values are not printed.
review_dimensions.network_start_boundary: Network starts only when handler.start is explicitly reached after readiness/configuration.
review_dimensions.dry_run_test_boundary: Injected handlers and import-smoke guards prevent real network start in tests.

review_units.rollback_considerations: Eager imports and the previous shutdown path must be restored together only after confirming readiness and signal semantics.
review_units.security_impact: Token output and network-start boundaries are intended to remain unchanged.
review_units.data_integrity_impact: Shutdown during an approval requires service/session rollback semantics to remain intact.
review_units.performance_impact: Slack Bolt import and handler allocation are deferred until explicit start.
known_limitations: No real Slack connection is made by this review preparation.
unresolved_issues: Human review must confirm production factory defaults are behaviorally equivalent.
test_evidence_gaps: No focused test forces Slack Bolt ImportError and asserts the fixed dependency error.
No integration test interrupts a real in-flight approval because Slack communication and production DB access are prohibited.
